tex_content.html:
Theorem
[3-manifolds with $\operatorname {Rm}\geq 0$ or $\operatorname {Ric}\geq 0$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0393 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-curvature-operator-strong-maximum-principle 1. appD:D.22\group Curvature Rigidity

For a Ricci flow on a closed three-manifold with nonnegative sectional, respectively Ricci, curvature, its universal covering flow at each positive time is either flat $\mathbb R^3$, a product $(S^2,h(t))\times \mathbb R$ with $h(t)$ positively curved, or has positive sectional, respectively Ricci, curvature. In the last case the universal cover is diffeomorphic to $S^3$ and the original manifold is a spherical space form.
